string.value: Installation is performed in two phases – "Caching" and "Installation after caching". During Caching, there is no system downtime and you can continue working on the system. During installation after caching, the software is installed on the system with some system downtime.
Resume installation after caching. Installation after caching is the actual installation process where you experience system downtime.
Press []Ctrl-B] to go back, []Ctrl-X] to quit, or []Enter] to install.
